reason: One unmaintained-transitive exception is tracked: chrono is a non-optional dependency of the MCP SDK (rmcp 3.x, all released versions) and of schemars, so it cannot be removed from this crate's tree. The advisory marks the crate unmaintained; it records no vulnerability, unsoundness or memory-safety finding. The direct use in this crate stays limited to timestamp formatting and parsing. Tracked so the gate keeps failing on anything new.

findings.why_it_stays: rmcp 3.9.0 and 3.11.0 both declare chrono as a non-optional dependency; schemars 1.x does the same. Dropping our direct dependency does not remove it from the tree.
findings.exit_condition: rmcp publishes a release without chrono, or the advisory is withdrawn.
